ultimate_foundations: chosen logic and ultimate checking root

work_packages.title: Freeze the completion contract.
work_packages.acceptance:
each
required feature and claim has a named semantics and an owning work package;
each provisional exclusion has an enforcement test and a scheduled closure step.
Removing a required feature changes the release charter rather than completing it.

work_packages.title: Replace prose-only gaps with an obligation graph.
work_packages.acceptance:
every current gap
maps to a package below; no dependency cycles are discharged by assuming each
other. Joint invariants or well-founded constructions must close such cycles.

work_packages.title: Pin and reproduce the entire build.

evidence.claim: nixpkgs, Shen-Scheme v0.52 archive, PR 117 overlay and Coq debs pinned by hash; nix build .#gates runs make test and make prove in the no-network sandbox
orchestrates the Nix and host routes; docs/BUILD.md records which targets were executed
manifest of sources, tool payloads, runtime libraries, commands, environment and outputs, plus a comparer that explains differences; identity evidence, not semantic evidence
host bootstrap and Nix sandbox builds of one commit gave byte-identical .vo/.glob/captures; .aux paths and timings and Shen run-time log lines are explained nondeterminism

work_packages.acceptance:
the
release can be rebuilt and its differences explained. Reproducibility establishes
identity evidence, never semantic preservation; steps 20–32 discharge that gap.

work_packages.title: Define observations, failures and external interaction.
work_packages.acceptance:
no later pass can hide an error, failed write or infinite internal loop by
choosing a weaker observation vocabulary.

work_packages.title: Complete the language value and store model.
work_packages.acceptance: each primitive domain and every accepted boundary value has defined meaning.

work_packages.title: Complete KLambda semantics.
work_packages.acceptance:
every
required KLambda form and primitive has a semantic rule; no full-language claim
is made from the existing first-order fragment alone.

work_packages.title: Verify the executable Shen semantics.
work_packages.acceptance:
every accepted
execution result has a formal witness, with the promised converse/completeness
within the stated evaluator profile and sufficient resources.

work_packages.title: Specify and prove the application contract logic.
work_packages.acceptance:
checked
derivability entails the stated semantic property under exactly the recorded
premises. This does not assert a terminating decision procedure for validity.

work_packages.title: Close every certificate checker and admission path.
work_packages.acceptance:
all acceptance routes imply the same soundness theorem; no alternate UI, cache,
serializer or fast path bypasses it. Native checker execution is closed in 32.

work_packages.title: Prove the Shen type/sequent and effect systems.
work_packages.acceptance:
each advertised “correct by construction” guarantee names a proved judgment;
post-check redefinition invalidates or revalidates dependent claims.

work_packages.title: Verify bytes, readers, codecs and tagging.
work_packages.acceptance:
the
artifact actually checked denotes the exact admitted bytes and no hidden suffix,
reader evaluation or metadata substitution can change their interpretation.

work_packages.title: Prove the complete Shen frontend.
work_packages.acceptance:
source properties reach
KLambda without an unproved “the frontend did the right thing” premise, including
errors, partial installation and dynamic definitions.

work_packages.title: Close the standard and application library surface.
work_packages.acceptance: no reachable helper is justified solely because it is “standard” or community code.

work_packages.title: Complete the generated Scheme and CL semantics.
work_packages.acceptance:
each
required emitted form has a meaning and a port-level refinement obligation.

work_packages.title: Finish the actual Shen-Scheme compiler.

evidence.claim: order_call_preserves/order_call_noncompletion: every successful run of the actual captured order-call pass (any gensym generator) yields syntax with identical completed outcomes, error payloads, state, trace and non-completion as the admitted input call

every branch of the captured order-call-inputs and fresh-call-variable loops, linked with the captured kernel occurrences/reverse/not, follows the keep/lift structure with names of zero occurrence count
decode is budget-monotone and reads every non-keyword-headed list as an application
exact Shen kernel 43.1 occurrences/reverse/reverse-help/not (renamed only), compiled by the actual Shen-Scheme compiler and regenerated by make prove
twelve sampled checks of the actual imported pass and kernel helpers; not a proof
swapped keep order, collision-accepting fresh loop, tail-dropping occurrence count and a reordered-argument restatement are rejected by Rocq

work_packages.acceptance: no required compiler branch remains an oracle or merely a sampled schema.

work_packages.title: Finish the actual Shen-CL compiler.

premises: qsafe: no quoted non-symbol comparand of shen-cl.equal?
CL evaluation model, reader, printer and SBCL execution are contracts
evidence.claim: For every input datum, every CL world (state type, primitive and opaque-form relations) and every compile-expression function, interpreting the admitted Shen-CL 4844072 emit-if/optimise-boolean-check/optimise-boolean-sequence/emit-boolean sources yields a CL IF whose condition is evaluated once and whose branch selection, results, errors and state traces match Shen boolean semantics.
The evaluator's shen-cl.true? rule equals running the captured primitives.lsp guard (CLPortCapture) in CLPortGuard's model.
The primitive_contracts hypotheses are jointly satisfiable by a concrete world (anti-vacuity; not a model of SBCL).

Inert reader-level capture of src/compiler.shen (blob 2d624377c02030f9513769f7bad11e84330b8c5a, with byte spans) admitted by computed equality against the reviewed expected AST; corollaries instantiate the universal theorems.
34 outputs of the actual compiler.shen, executed on the Buri Shen host (not SBCL), equal the Rocq interpretation of the admitted capture.
Opt-in SBCL 2.6.8 samples of every named primitive contract and of the |and|/|or| macros, plus a sample showing the qsafe premise is necessary.
Opt-in gate: fresh regeneration must be byte-identical; dropped-guard, cl-truthiness, swapped-branches and eq-for-equal captures are rejected by Rocq admission.

work_packages.acceptance:
the same Shen
contract can be transported through either port, with explicit port-specific
representation and platform premises and no missing compiler branch.

work_packages.title: Discharge every primitive and helper wrapper.
work_packages.acceptance:
no root is
hidden behind an aggregate “runtime behaves correctly” assumption.

work_packages.title: Verify the whole observer and provenance pipeline.
work_packages.acceptance:
successful evidence describes exactly the code installed, while
native IO and deployment identity obligations flow explicitly to 26–31.

work_packages.title: Verify dynamic eval, loading and redefinition.
work_packages.acceptance:
all execution entry points, including REPL/FFI callbacks and mutable code objects,
are covered. A sealed-only milestone is not full dynamic Shen coverage.

work_packages.title: Establish the authoritative ARM proof foundation.

evidence.claim: Exact tool pins, compatibility results, trust-boundary audit draft and a provisional ISA/toolchain pin. Proves no theorem: no byte-level theorem against the ISA model exists yet and Islaris was not built, so the exit criterion is unmet.
Exact 152-byte tarm64le code object from plain Chez 10.3.0 for Shen-Scheme v0.52's generated form of (define buri-arm-add X Y -> (+ X Y)); one relocated instance; executed under qemu-aarch64 only.
Exact 680-byte code component produced inside Shen-CL 4844072d on aarch64 SBCL 2.6.8; executed under qemu-aarch64 only.
x86_64 only: in-process Shen-Scheme v0.52 code equals plain Chez 10.3.0 code modulo three relocated addresses, for one function.
isla e9b5d945 symbolic execution of the Sail Armv9.4-A IR on the exact opcode bytes; trusts isla, z3 and the Sail-to-IR translation; not checked by Rocq.

work_packages.acceptance:
exact
instructions are checked against the selected ISA model; no disassembly-text or
toy-ISA agreement is substituted. Tool compatibility and missing mechanisms are
research deliverables, not assumed available integrations.

work_packages.title: Prove both native representation relations.
work_packages.acceptance:
all native values and
memory accesses used by the admitted execution paths have justified meanings.

work_packages.title: Close Chez compilation to ARM.
work_packages.acceptance:
every required code
path/configuration is handled, or a universal compiler proof supplies the result.
A validator may reject an output safely, but cannot then claim universal coverage
of that unsupported required output. Generic closure uses compositional schemas,
not a test corpus. Proving outputs does not claim all unrelated Chez programs or
all possible compiler invocations are correct.

work_packages.title: Close SBCL compilation to ARM.
work_packages.acceptance:
the SBCL execution path has
the same coverage standard as Chez, without treating SBCL as a trusted oracle.

work_packages.title: Verify native runtime code and support libraries.
work_packages.acceptance:
no opaque native call remains in a required path. Replacing a dependency
with smaller code requires a proved API refinement and an explicit version change.

work_packages.title: Verify allocation and garbage collection.
work_packages.acceptance:
successful collections and all modeled failure paths preserve the runtime
invariant; there is no implicit “GC works” premise.

work_packages.title: Verify the executable lifecycle and exact loaded bytes.
work_packages.acceptance:
no gap remains between proved binary contents and modeled loaded code;
secure boot/physical identity roots are separately recorded in 31–32.

work_packages.title: Prove OS/ABI and IO boundary implementations.
work_packages.acceptance:
every interaction is explicit and wrapper correctness is discharged.
The remaining OS implementation relations are mandatory inputs to step 31,
not a declaration that the whole deployment is finished.

work_packages.title: Close concurrency, scheduling and ARM weak memory.
work_packages.acceptance:
all admitted interleavings and actual
runtime threads are covered; a sequential test cannot close this package.

work_packages.title: Connect TLA+ and distributed behavior.
work_packages.acceptance:
safety and conditional liveness are proved under
the exact fault/environment model; arbitrary permanent partition or hardware
failure is not hidden behind an unconditional availability claim.

work_packages.title: Prove security and resource claims separately.
work_packages.acceptance:
each
advertised guarantee has the right theorem, with environmental liveness and
physical side-channel assumptions exposed. No claim of universal termination.

work_packages.title: Close the deployment software below the process.
work_packages.acceptance:
no required software component is an unproved OS oracle.
Existing kernel proofs must be bridged into the checking trust story; assumptions
about unverified configurations, assembly or initialization are not inherited
silently. Hardware/device behavior remains an explicit physical foundation.

work_packages.title: Close checker execution and bootstrap trust.
work_packages.acceptance:
neither Shen execution nor an unproved extraction/compiler silently
decides theorem validity in the final acceptance route.

work_packages.title: Prove complete application examples on both ports.
work_packages.acceptance:
each example is end to end; finite examples demonstrate integration, while the
generic language/compiler results establish coverage beyond those examples.
Future applications still require their own contracts and certificates.

work_packages.title: Prove the composition theorem and close every premise.
work_packages.acceptance:
zero unproved software premises outside the declared ultimate checking root for
the closed endpoint and
zero required coverage holes. Unsupported output safely rejected by a validator
remains a coverage failure until its required case is implemented and proved.

work_packages.title: Make closure enforceable in CI and deployment.

evidence.claim: build manifests bind source, tool-payload, runtime-library, flag and proof-object hashes; not yet a signed bundle or deploy-time admission protocol

work_packages.acceptance:
modifying
any correctness-relevant input invalidates the old proof bundle, and no mutable
label or forgeable success token authorizes execution. Nix/Earthbuild repeatability
and signed provenance support this process but do not replace semantic checks.

work_packages.title: Perform independent closure review and release.
work_packages.acceptance:
every mandatory package
has its acceptance evidence and the final theorem applies to the bytes deployed.
Subsequent upgrades reopen affected obligations automatically. The release can
be complete even though future programs, platforms and hardware require new work.
